name: 86 Chaos 16.0.113 Firestore Rules Compiler Complexity Hotfix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.113 Firestore Rules Compiler Complexity Hotfix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.113 Firestore Rules Compiler Complexity Hotfix
notes: Flattens deeply nested platform-authority create checks into direct boolean guards while preserving every privileged-field denial.
Reuses one current-user, membership, permission, and restaurant lookup per authority decision instead of repeatedly chaining safeUserData, exists, and get calls.
Collapses subscription-plan evaluation and financial-read authority paths to reduce remote Firestore Rules compiler work without changing tier or role access.
Keeps the daily-close field allowlist, tenant binding, date format, text limits, and critical total limits in Firestore while moving exhaustive amount validation into the app save flow.
Includes the 16.0.112 blank-email authority correction so missing email claims can never match missing owner-email fields.
